verdict.rationale: Circle documents x402 by name across several concrete surfaces. Sellers can make an endpoint return 402 Payment Required and serve the resource once a valid USDC payment is attached. A public Discovery API lists x402 services, and Agent Nanopayments plus the CLI let agents pay for x402 services in sub-cent USDC. This is shipped infrastructure, not a blog aspiration. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of the x402 flow, and no evidence of ACP, MPP or AP2 support.
